limitations: OS private bytes include engine, browser and subprocesses. Working set sums can double-count shared mappings. Peak is sampled, not guaranteed absolute maximum. CDP GC covers page JS only; it does not prove complete native/WASM reclamation. WeakRef counts cover selected File objects and parent-page Blob URL inputs, without retaining them or recording names. Firefox/WebKit do not have forced page GC here, so live weak references are not by themselves proof of a leak. No instrumentation retaining frames.
